summary: Detaylı Hareket Raporu (/report tab) end-to-end verified. Seeded via API: 2 temp stores (TEST_DTR_A US,CA / TEST_DTR_B US) + 6 transactions (USD + CAD, income/expense, Order payments/Refunds/Service Fees). fulfillment_type patched directly in MongoDB (FBA/FBM/UNKNOWN) and 3 amazon_order_items inserted — ONLY touched test records. UI check at /report → 'Detaylı Hareket Raporu' tab: all required data-testids present (dtr-direction, dtr-fulfillment, dtr-search, dtr-order-id, dtr-total-income, dtr-net-profit, dtr-record-count, dtr-page-size-25/50/100, dtr-export-csv, dtr-export-xlsx), KPIs populate from backend (Net Kâr -$279.73, Kayıt Sayısı 1 on default year range for current data), row click opens dtr-detail-dialog, page-size 50 button toggles, search box filters to dtr-empty state when no match. report-store/report-marketplace page-level filters feed the DTR query via baseQuery.
critical_code_review_comments: transaction_report.py reuses finance.summarize + usd_ledger.effective_usd_costs via build_row(converted record) and filtered_summary — guarantees no second formula. filtered_summary derives total_income from s['revenue'] and total_effective_cost from s['expenses'] minus own-expense sum, so FBM/FBA accounting stays consistent with P&L. Verified by parity test (net_profit matches /portfolio/summary within $0.05).

FBA realized cost only on carrier row: _fifo_carrier(tx) requires fifo.carrier_tx_id == tx.id; remaining FBA inventory never counted as expense. Non-carrier FBA rows show fba_product_cost/fba_inbound_cost from costs dict (0 if not carrier) — correct per spec.

Filter composition: direction overrides base {'$in': ['income','expense']} by setting type explicitly; fulfillment=UNKNOWN maps to {'$in': ['UNKNOWN', None, '']} which correctly captures legacy records without the field. Pagination 25/50/100 enforced; out-of-range page clamps to total_pages.

Export reuses the same run() so CSV/XLSX contain exactly the filtered rows. _safe prefixes formula-injection chars with apostrophe. XLSX 'Filtre Özeti' sheet lists active filters (excluding sort/order) — good audit trail.
No MongoDB _id leaks (projections exclude _id in both docs and amazon_order_items; detail endpoint also strips user_id). Backend uses async/await throughout.
